outcome: prevalence of sickle cell disease and related conditions
cohort: 600 tribal patients attending outpatient and inpatient departments (medicine, surgery, and gynecology) of GMC Shahdol hospital in routine or emergency from September 2021 to March 2023.
finding: Among 600 screened tribal patients, the prevalence of sickle cell trait was 88.7%, sickle cell disease was 9.02%, sickle beta thalassemia was 1.68%, B Thalassemia Minor was 0.25%, and B Thalassemia Major was 0.33%.
